Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  CI — acme/platform monorepo
#
#  lint / typecheck / unit / e2e for every workspace package touched by a change.
#  The Turborepo remote cache is shared with the Vercel team (see TURBO_* below),
#  so a green run on main usually makes PR runs ~3x faster.
#
#  Owners: dev-infra. Ping #dev-infra before touching the matrix -- the branch
#  protection ruleset matches jobs by *name*.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main,'release/**' ]
    paths-ignore:
    - '**.md'
    - 'docs/**'
    - .changeset/**
    - "LICENSE"
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - ready_for_review
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      debug:
        description: 'Open a tmate session when a job fails'
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read     # dorny/paths-filter needs this on PRs
  checks: write

env:
  TURBO_TOKEN:    ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}
  TURBO_TEAM:     ${{ vars.TURBO_TEAM }}
  TURBO_REMOTE_ONLY:      true
  NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096
  FORCE_COLOR: "1"
  PNPM_VERSION:   8.15.4
  # HUSKY: 0      # not needed anymore, husky v9 skips itself when CI=true
  DO_NOT_TRACK: 1


jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      packages:  ${{ steps.filter.outputs.packages }}
      web:       ${{ steps.filter.outputs.web }}
      api:       ${{ steps.filter.outputs.api }}
      e2e:       ${{ steps.filter.outputs.e2e }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
      id: filter
      with:
        # keep in sync with the "inputs" globs in turbo.json  (FIXME: generate this from turbo.json?)
        filters: |
          packages:
            - 'packages/**'
            - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
            - 'turbo.json'
          web:
            - 'apps/web/**'
            - 'packages/ui/**'
          api:
            - 'apps/api/**'
            - 'packages/db/**'
          e2e:
            - 'apps/**'
            - 'e2e/**'
            - 'playwright.config.ts'


  lint:
    name: Lint
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.packages == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0     # turbo --filter=...[origin/main] needs the history
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: ESLint + Prettier (affected packages only)
        run: pnpm turbo run lint format:check --filter="...[origin/${{ github.base_ref || 'main' }}]"
      # - name: Stylelint
      #   run: pnpm -r --parallel exec stylelint "**/*.css"
      #   (disabled until the design-system migration lands, see #1873)

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.packages == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
      with: { version: "${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}" }
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version-file: .nvmrc
        cache: pnpm
    - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    - run: pnpm turbo run typecheck --continue



  test:
    name: Unit (node ${{ matrix.node }}, ${{ matrix.os }}, ${{ matrix.shard }})
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.packages == 'true'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 8
      matrix:
        node: [ 18, 20,22 ]
        os:   [ubuntu-latest , windows-latest]
        shard: [1/3, 2/3, 3/3]
        experimental: [false]
        exclude:
          # node 18 + windows + vitest threads = random segfaults, see #2291
          - os: windows-latest
            node: 18
        include:
          -   node: 23
              os: ubuntu-latest
              shard: 1/1
              experimental: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup node ${{ matrix.node }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache:   pnpm

      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline

      - name: Test
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # only packages affected since main (plus their dependents)
          pnpm turbo run test --filter=...[origin/main] -- \
            --shard=${{ matrix.shard }} \
            --reporter=default --reporter=junit \
            --outputFile.junit=reports/junit-${{ matrix.node }}-${{ strategy.job-index }}.xml
        env:
          TZ: UTC
          VITEST_MAX_THREADS:   4
          VITEST_SEGFAULT_RETRY: 3

      - name: Upload test reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: junit-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.node }}-${{ strategy.job-index }}
          path: '**/reports/junit-*.xml'
          retention-days: 05
          if-no-files-found: ignore

          # tmate only when explicitly requested via workflow_dispatch
      - name: Debug session
        if: ${{ failure() && inputs.debug }}
        uses: mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3
        with:
          limit-access-to-actor: true

  e2e:
    name: E2E (Playwright)
    needs: [changes, test]
    if: >-
      needs.changes.outputs.e2e == 'true' &&
      github.event.pull_request.draft != true
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: acme
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: acme
          POSTGRES_DB:    acme_e2e
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U acme"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      redis:
         image: redis:7
         ports: [ '6379:6379' ]
         options: --health-cmd "redis-cli ping" --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5 --health-start-period 5s
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://acme:acme@localhost:5432/acme_e2e
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
      BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
      PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
      SENTRY_DSN:
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
      with:
        version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: 20
        cache: pnpm
    - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    - name: Cache Playwright browsers
      id: pw-cache
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
        key: playwright-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
    - name: Install browsers
      if: steps.pw-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
    - name: Migrate + seed
      run: |
        pnpm --filter @acme/db run migrate:deploy
        pnpm --filter @acme/db run seed -- --profile e2e
    - name: Start app & wait for it
      run: |
        pnpm turbo run start --filter=@acme/web --filter=@acme/api > app.log 2>&1 &
        for i in $(seq 1 90); do
          if curl -fsS "$BASE_URL/api/health" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "app is up after ${i}s"
            exit 0
          fi
          sleep 1
        done
        echo "::error::app did not come up within 90s"
        tail -n 200 app.log
        exit 1
    - name: Run e2e
      run: pnpm exec playwright test --project=chromium --reporter=github,html
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
      with:
        name: playwright-report
        path: |
          playwright-report/
          app.log
        retention-days: 7


  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [lint, typecheck, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm turbo run build --filter="./apps/*" --summarize
      - name: Upload build output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            apps/web/.next/
            !apps/web/.next/cache
            apps/api/dist/
          retention-days: 05

      - name: Notify Slack on failure
        if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'push' }}
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.26.0
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:  ${{ secrets.SLACK_CI_WEBHOOK }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_TYPE: INCOMING_WEBHOOK
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "text": ":red_circle: CI failed on `${{ github.ref_name }}`",
              "blocks": [
                {
                  "type": "section",
                  "text": {
                    "type": "mrkdwn",
                    "text": "*<${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}|CI run #${{ github.run_number }}>* failed on `${{ github.ref_name }}` (${{ github.actor }})"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }

  # Single required status check for the branch ruleset. If you rename this job,
  # update Settings > Rules > "main" as well or every PR will hang forever.
  ci-ok:
    name: CI OK
    if: always()
    needs: [ lint, typecheck,test, e2e, build ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: All required jobs passed (or were skipped)
        run: |
          echo '${{ toJSON(needs) }}' | jq -e 'all(.[]; .result == "success" or .result == "skipped")'

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  CI — acme/platform monorepo
#
#  lint / typecheck / unit / e2e for every workspace package touched by a change.
#  Turbo remote cache is shared with the Vercel team (see TURBO_* below).
#  Ping #dev-infra before touching the matrix -- branch protection matches jobs by *name*.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main,'release/**' ]
    paths-ignore:
    - '**.md'
    - 'docs/**'
    - .changeset/**
    - "LICENSE"
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - ready_for_review
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      debug:
        description: 'Open a tmate session when a job fails'
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read     # dorny/paths-filter needs this on PRs

env:
  TURBO_TOKEN:    ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}
  TURBO_TEAM:     ${{ vars.TURBO_TEAM }}
  TURBO_REMOTE_ONLY:      true
  NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096
  FORCE_COLOR: "1"
  PNPM_VERSION:   8.15.4
  # HUSKY: 0      # not needed anymore, husky v9 skips itself when CI=true
  DO_NOT_TRACK: 1


jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      packages:  ${{ steps.filter.outputs.packages }}
      web:       ${{ steps.filter.outputs.web }}
      e2e:       ${{ steps.filter.outputs.e2e }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
      id: filter
      with:
        # keep in sync with the "inputs" globs in turbo.json  (FIXME: generate this from turbo.json?)
        filters: |
          packages:
            - 'packages/**'
            - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
          web:
            - 'apps/web/**'
            - 'packages/ui/**'
          e2e:
            - 'apps/**'
            - 'e2e/**'


  lint:
    name: Lint
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.packages == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0     # turbo --filter=...[origin/main] needs the history
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: ESLint + Prettier (affected packages only)
        run: pnpm turbo run lint format:check --filter="...[origin/${{ github.base_ref || 'main' }}]"
      # - name: Stylelint
      #   run: pnpm -r --parallel exec stylelint "**/*.css"
      #   (disabled until the design-system migration lands, see #1873)

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.packages == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
      with: { version: "${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}" }
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version-file: .nvmrc
        cache: pnpm
    - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    - run: pnpm turbo run typecheck --continue



  test:
    name: Unit (node ${{ matrix.node }}, ${{ matrix.os }}, ${{ matrix.shard }})
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.packages == 'true'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [ 18, 20,22 ]
        os:   [ubuntu-latest , windows-latest]
        shard: [1/3, 2/3, 3/3]
        experimental: [false]
        exclude:
          # node 18 + windows + vitest threads = random segfaults, see #2291
          - os: windows-latest
            node: 18
        include:
          -   node: 23
              os: ubuntu-latest
              shard: 1/1
              experimental: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
      - name: Setup node ${{ matrix.node }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache:   pnpm

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
      - name: Test
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # only packages affected since main (plus their dependents)
          pnpm turbo run test --filter=...[origin/main] -- \
            --shard=${{ matrix.shard }} \
            --reporter=default --reporter=junit \
            --outputFile.junit=reports/junit-${{ matrix.node }}-${{ strategy.job-index }}.xml
        env:
          TZ: UTC
          VITEST_MAX_THREADS:   4

      - name: Upload test reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: junit-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.node }}-${{ strategy.job-index }}
          path: '**/reports/junit-*.xml'
          retention-days: 05
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          # tmate only when explicitly requested via workflow_dispatch
      - name: Debug session
        if: ${{ failure() && inputs.debug }}
        uses: mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3
        with:
          limit-access-to-actor: true

  e2e:
    name: E2E (Playwright)
    needs: [changes, test]
    if: >-
      needs.changes.outputs.e2e == 'true' &&
      github.event.pull_request.draft != true
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: acme
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: acme
          POSTGRES_DB:    acme_e2e
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U acme"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      redis:
         image: redis:7
         ports: [ '6379:6379' ]
         options: --health-cmd "redis-cli ping" --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5 --health-start-period 5s
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://acme:acme@localhost:5432/acme_e2e
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
      BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
      PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
      SENTRY_DSN:
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
      with:
        version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: 20
        cache: pnpm
    - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    - run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
    - name: Migrate + seed
      run: |
        pnpm --filter @acme/db run migrate:deploy
        pnpm --filter @acme/db run seed -- --profile e2e
    - name: Start app & wait for it
      run: |
        pnpm turbo run start --filter=@acme/web --filter=@acme/api > app.log 2>&1 &
        for i in $(seq 1 90); do
          curl -fsS "$BASE_URL/api/health" > /dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0
          sleep 1
        done
        echo "::error::app did not come up within 90s"; tail -n 200 app.log; exit 1
    - name: Run e2e
      run: pnpm exec playwright test --project=chromium --reporter=github,html
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
      with:
        name: playwright-report
        path: |
          playwright-report/
          app.log
        retention-days: 7


  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [lint, typecheck, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm turbo run build --filter="./apps/*" --summarize
      - name: Upload build output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            apps/web/.next/
            !apps/web/.next/cache
            apps/api/dist/
          retention-days: 05
      - name: Notify Slack on failure
        if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'push' }}
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.26.0
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:  ${{ secrets.SLACK_CI_WEBHOOK }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_TYPE: INCOMING_WEBHOOK
        with:
          payload: |
            {"text": ":red_circle: CI failed on `${{ github.ref_name }}` (${{ github.actor }}): ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}",
             "username": "ci-bot", "icon_emoji": ":rotating_light:"}

  # Single required status check for the branch ruleset. If you rename this job,
  # update Settings > Rules > "main" as well or every PR will hang forever.
  ci-ok:
    name: CI OK
    if: always()
    needs: [ lint, typecheck,test, e2e, build ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: All required jobs passed (or were skipped)
        run: |
          echo '${{ toJSON(needs) }}' | jq -e 'all(.[]; .result == "success" or .result == "skipped")'

# Release pipeline for `acmectl`
#
# Triggered by pushing a tag like v1.4.0 / v1.5.0-rc.1, or manually from the Actions
# tab (handy for re-running a botched release -- delete the draft release first!).
#
#   artifacts : tar.gz for linux + macOS, zip for windows, SHA256SUMS
#   publishes : GitHub release, Homebrew tap (stable only)
---
name: Release

on:
    push:
        tags: ['v*.*.*']
    workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
            version:
                description: Version to release without the leading v, e.g. 1.4.0 or 1.5.0-rc.1 (must match Cargo.toml and the tag you pushed)
                required: true
                type: string
            prerelease: { type: boolean, default: false }
            dry-run:
                description: "Build everything but don't publish anything"
                type: boolean
                default: no

permissions: { contents: write, packages: write, id-token: write }

env:
    BIN_NAME: acmectl
    CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    # bump when the release notes template changes
    NOTES_TEMPLATE_VERSION: '2'
    MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.13
    # set to 'true' once the new code-signing cert is in the org secrets (INFRA-882)
    SIGNING_ENABLED:


jobs:
    prepare:
        name: Prepare
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        outputs:
            version: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
            tag: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}
            is_prerelease: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.is_prerelease }}
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            - id: meta
              name: Compute version
              shell: bash
              run: |
                  set -euo pipefail
                  if [[ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
                      VERSION="${{ inputs.version }}"
                  else
                      VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
                  fi
                  echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "tag=v${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  # anything with a dash (1.5.0-rc.1) is a prerelease
                  if [[ "$VERSION" == *-* || "${{ inputs.prerelease }}" == "true" ]]; then
                      echo "is_prerelease=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  else
                      echo "is_prerelease=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  fi
            - name: Check Cargo.toml agrees
              run: |
                  CARGO_VERSION=$(grep -m1 '^version' Cargo.toml | cut -d '"' -f2)
                  if [ "$CARGO_VERSION" != "${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}" ]; then
                      echo "::error::Cargo.toml says $CARGO_VERSION but we're releasing ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}"
                      exit 1
                  fi

    build:
        name: Build ${{ matrix.target }}
        needs: prepare
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
        strategy:
            fail-fast: true
            matrix:
                include:
                    - { os: ubuntu-latest, target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, archive: tar.gz }
                    - { os: ubuntu-latest,  target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl,   archive: tar.gz, cross: true }
                    - {os: ubuntu-latest, target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, archive: tar.gz, cross: true}
                    - { os: macos-13,       target: x86_64-apple-darwin,      archive: tar.gz }
                    - { os: macos-14 , target: aarch64-apple-darwin , archive: tar.gz }
                    - { os: windows-latest, target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, archive: zip,ext: .exe }
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
            with:
              targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
          - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
            with:
              key: ${{ matrix.target }}

          - name: Install cross
            if: matrix.cross
            run: cargo install cross --locked --git https://github.com/cross-rs/cross --rev 44011c8

          - name: Build
            shell: bash
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              CARGO=cargo
              [[ "${{ matrix.cross }}" == "true" ]] && CARGO=cross
              $CARGO build --release --locked --target ${{ matrix.target }}

          - name: Sign binary (windows)
            if: runner.os == 'Windows' && env.SIGNING_ENABLED == 'true'
            shell: pwsh
            env:
              SIGN_CERT_B64: ${{ secrets.WINDOWS_SIGN_CERT }}
              SIGN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.WINDOWS_SIGN_PASSWORD }}
            run: |
              $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# action.yml — acme/setup-toolchain
#
# Composite action used by ~40 repos in the org. Breaking input changes => new major
# tag (v4); everything else ships as v3.x.y and the floating v3 tag gets moved.
#
#   - uses: acme/setup-toolchain@v3
#     with:
#       node-version-file: .nvmrc
#       registry-token: ${{ secrets.ACME_NPM_TOKEN }}
#
name: 'Setup Acme toolchain'
description: >-
  Installs Node.js, pnpm (via corepack) and the acme CLI, restores the pnpm store
  and the local turbo cache, and configures auth for the internal npm registry so
  that `pnpm install` works for packages in the @acme scope. Works on ubuntu-*,
  macos-* and windows-* runners; self-hosted runners need curl, tar and gh on PATH.
author: 'Acme Developer Infrastructure <dev-infra@acme.example.com>'
branding: { icon: 'package', color: "blue" }

inputs:
  node-version:
    description: "Node.js version spec (20, 20.x, lts/*). Ignored when node-version-file is set."
    required: false
    default: "20.x"
  node-version-file:
     description: Path to a file with the Node.js version to use, usually .nvmrc or .node-version (package.json is read via engines.node)
     required: 'false'
     default: ''
  pnpm-version:
    description: 'pnpm version. Empty = use "packageManager" from package.json'
    required: false
    default: ''
  acme-cli-version:
    description: Version of the acme CLI to install (without the v)
    required: false
    default: 2.14.0
  registry-url:
    description: "Registry for the @acme scope"
    required: false
    default: https://npm.pkg.github.com
  registry-token:
     description: |
       Token with read:packages for the @acme scope.
       In most repos this is secrets.ACME_NPM_TOKEN (org secret). GITHUB_TOKEN only
       works if the calling repo was granted access in the package settings.
     required: TRUE
  token:
    description: GitHub token used to download the acme CLI release asset
    required: false
    default: ${{ github.token }}
  cache:
    description: Restore / save the pnpm store
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  turbo-cache:
    description: Restore .turbo between runs (local cache only -- the remote cache is configured through TURBO_TOKEN)
    required: false
    default: yes
  cache-key-suffix:
    description: "Appended to the cache key, e.g. to bust a poisoned cache"
    required: false
    default: ''
  install:
    description: 'Run pnpm install after setup'
    required: false
    default: "true"
  install-args:
    description: Extra args for pnpm install
    required: false
    default: --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
  working-directory:
    description: Where to run pnpm install
    required: false
    default: .
  always-auth:
    description: Set always-auth in .npmrc
    required: false
    default: 'false'
    deprecationMessage: "always-auth is ignored by npm >= 9 and will be removed in v4 of this action. Drop it from your workflow to silence this warning."
  # debug:  (moved to ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG, see CHANGELOG 3.6.0)

outputs:
  node-version:
    description: "The resolved Node.js version, e.g. v20.11.1"
    value: ${{ steps.node.outputs.node-version }}
  pnpm-store-path:
    description: Path of the pnpm content-addressable store
    value: ${{ steps.pnpm.outputs.store-path }}
  cache-hit:
    description: Whether the pnpm store was restored from an exact key match
    value: ${{ steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
  acme-cli-path:
    value: ${{ steps.cli.outputs.path }}
    description: ~


runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    -   name: Setup Node.js
        id: node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version-file == '' && inputs.node-version || '' }}
          node-version-file: ${{ inputs.node-version-file }}

    -   name: Setup pnpm
        id: pnpm
        shell: bash
        env:
          PNPM_VERSION: ${{ inputs.pnpm-version }}
        run: |-
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "$PNPM_VERSION" ]; then
            PNPM_VERSION=$(node -p "(require('./package.json').packageManager || 'pnpm@8.15.4').split('@')[1]")
          fi
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare "pnpm@${PNPM_VERSION}" --activate
          echo "store-path=$(pnpm store path --silent)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    -   name: Restore pnpm store
        id: cache
        if: inputs.cache == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ steps.pnpm.outputs.store-path }}
            ~/.cache/Cypress
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-tool-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml', '**/package-lock.json') }}${{ inputs.cache-key-suffix }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-tool-
      # 'yes' is the documented default but older callers pass 'true' -- accept both
    -   name: Restore turbo cache
        if: inputs.turbo-cache == 'true' || inputs.turbo-cache == 'yes'
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}/.turbo
          key: turbo-${{ runner.os }}-${{ github.job }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
             turbo-${{ runner.os }}-${{ github.job }}-
             turbo-${{ runner.os }}-

    -   name: Install acme CLI
        id: cli
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.token }}
          ACME_CLI_VERSION: ${{ inputs.acme-cli-version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${RUNNER_OS}" in
            Linux)   asset="acme-linux-amd64.tar.gz" ;;
            macOS)   asset="acme-darwin-universal.tar.gz" ;;
            Windows) asset="acme-windows-amd64.zip" ;;
          esac
          dest="${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/acme/${ACME_CLI_VERSION}"
          mkdir -p "$dest"
          if [ ! -x "$dest/acme" ] && [ ! -f "$dest/acme.exe" ]; then
            gh release download "v${ACME_CLI_VERSION}" --repo acme/acme-cli --pattern "$asset" --dir "$dest"
            (cd "$dest" && (tar xzf "$asset" 2>/dev/null || unzip -oq "$asset"))
          fi
          echo "$dest" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          echo "path=$dest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    -   name: Configure registry auth
        shell: bash
        env:
            NPMRC: ${{ runner.temp }}/.npmrc
            REGISTRY_URL: ${{ inputs.registry-url }}
        run: |
          host="${REGISTRY_URL#https://}"
          echo "@acme:registry=${REGISTRY_URL}" >> "$NPMRC"
          echo "//${host%/}/:_authToken=${{ inputs.registry-token }}" >> "$NPMRC"
          if [ "${{ inputs.always-auth }}" = "true" ]; then echo "always-auth=true" >> "$NPMRC"; fi
          echo "NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG=$NPMRC" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

    -   name: pnpm install
        if: inputs.install == 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}
        run: pnpm install ${{ inputs.install-args }}

    -   name: Summary
        if: ${{ runner.debug == '1' }}
        shell: bash
        run: >
          echo "node $(node --version), pnpm $(pnpm --version),
          acme $(acme --version 2>/dev/null || echo n/a),
          cache-hit=${{ steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit || 'n/a' }}"

name: tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
    - main
    - 'maint/**'
    tags: [ 'v*' ]
  pull_request:
  schedule:

   cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: 1
  PY_COLORS: "1"
  FORCE_COLOR: 1
  # nox re-uses venvs between sessions when this is set; uv makes venv creation ~10x faster
  NOX_DEFAULT_VENV_BACKEND: uv
  HYPOTHESIS_PROFILE: ci


jobs:

  pre-commit:
    name: pre-commit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1
        with:
          extra_args: --all-files --show-diff-on-failure

  test:
    name: py${{ matrix.python-version }} / ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: pre-commit
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10', 3.11, "3.12", '3.13-dev']
        os: [
            ubuntu-latest,
            macos-latest,     # arm64 since 2024-04, see #412
            windows-latest
          ]
        include:
          # PyPy only on linux, it's slow enough already
          - python-version: 'pypy3.10'
            os: ubuntu-latest
            experimental: true

          # "oldest supported dependencies" job
          - python-version: 3.10      # FIXME: unquoted -> YAML float 3.1, so this spins up Python 3.1 (!!) instead of extending the 3.10 job
            os: ubuntu-20.04
            deps: minimum

          - python-version: '3.13-dev'
            os: ubuntu-latest
            experimental: true
        exclude:
          - python-version: '3.13-dev'
            os: windows-latest
          # no 3.9 build for macos arm64 in setup-python
          - { python-version: '3.9', os: macos-latest }
          - {python-version: '3.13-dev',os: macos-latest}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0   # setuptools-scm needs the tags

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          allow-prereleases: true
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pyproject.toml
            requirements/*.txt

      - name: Install
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel
          python -m pip install -e ".[test]"
          python -m pip install nox uv

      - name: Pin minimum versions
        if: matrix.deps == 'minimum'
        run: python -m pip install -r requirements/minimum.txt

      - name: Run tests
        run: nox -s tests-${{ matrix.python-version }} -- --cov --cov-report=xml -n auto
        continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
        env:
          ACME_TEST_NETWORK: off
          ACME_CACHE_DIR: null

      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage.xml
          flags: ${{ runner.os }},py${{ matrix.python-version }}
          fail_ci_if_error: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
          verbose: TRUE

      - name: Job summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |+
          echo "### ${{ matrix.os }} / Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "* status: **${{ job.status }}**" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

    - name: Linkcheck

---
# CI for the `quiver` workspace (quiver, quiver-core, quiver-derive)
#
#   fmt ────┐
#   clippy ─┼─> test (matrix) ──> coverage
#   deny ───┘
#
# MSRV lives in Cargo.toml (`rust-version`) AND in the matrix below. Keep them in
# sync, `cargo xtask msrv` yells at you otherwise.

name: Rust CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, 'release-*' ]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 3 * * 0"     # weekly: new nightly + new clippy lints

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUSTFLAGS: "-D warnings"
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
  CARGO_NET_RETRY:   10
  RUSTUP_MAX_RETRIES:   10

jobs:
  fmt:
    name: rustfmt
    runs-on:   ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      with: { components: rustfmt }
    - run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

  clippy:
    name: clippy (${{ matrix.toolchain }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        toolchain: [ stable,beta ]
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
      with:
        toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        components: clippy
    - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      with: {key: "clippy-${{ matrix.toolchain }}"}
    - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D clippy::all -W clippy::pedantic -A clippy::module_name_repetitions


  test:
    name:
      test ${{ matrix.rust }} / ${{ matrix.os }}
      ${{ matrix.target && format('({0})', matrix.target) || '' }}
    needs: [fmt, clippy]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.rust == 'nightly' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        rust: [stable, beta, nightly, 1.74.0]
            # NB: never write the MSRV as e.g. `msrv: 1.70` -- YAML reads that as the
            # float 1.7 and rustup then tries to install 1.7.0. Ask me how I know.
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        exclude:
        - rust: beta
          os: macos-latest
        - rust: beta
          os: windows-latest
        - { rust: 1.74.0,  os: windows-latest }
        include:
        - rust: stable
          os: ubuntu-latest
          target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          use-cross: true
        - rust: stable
          os: ubuntu-latest
          target: i686-unknown-linux-gnu
          use-cross: true
          features: "--no-default-features"
        - rust: stable
          os: ubuntu-latest
          target: armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
          use-cross: true
          features: --no-default-features --features std
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key:   ${{ matrix.target }}
          cache-on-failure: true
      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.use-cross
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with: { tool: cross }
      - name: Test
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.use-cross }}" = "true" ]; then
            cross test --workspace --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.features }}
          else
            cargo test --workspace ${{ matrix.features || '--all-features' }} --no-fail-fast
          fi
      - name: Doctests
        if: matrix.rust == 'stable' && !matrix.target
        run: cargo test --doc --workspace --all-features



  miri:
    name: miri (UB check)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: fmt
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with: { toolchain: nightly, components: "miri, rust-src" }
      - run: cargo miri setup
      - run: cargo miri test -p quiver-core --lib
        env:
            MIRIFLAGS: -Zmiri-strict-provenance -Zmiri-symbolic-alignment-check
            # MIRIFLAGS: -Zmiri-disable-isolation   # once we test the fs module

  cargo-deny:
    name: cargo-deny
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action@v1
      with:
        command: check bans licenses sources
        arguments: --all-features
        rust-version: "1.74.0"
  # advisories can start failing any day (new RUSTSEC entries) -- don't block PRs on them
    - uses: EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action@v1
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        command: check advisories

  coverage:
    name: coverage
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cargo-llvm-cov
      - name: Collect coverage
        run: cargo llvm-cov --workspace --all-features --lcov --output-path lcov.info
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          files: lcov.info
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          fail_ci_if_error: false
          flags: unittests

  semver-checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: obi1kenobi/cargo-semver-checks-action@v2
        with:
          package: quiver, quiver-core
          feature-group: all-features
          # baseline-rev: v0.9.0

  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTDOCFLAGS: --cfg docsrs -D warnings
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - run: cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --all-features
      - name: Private items too
        run: cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --document-private-items
        env: { RUSTDOCFLAGS: "-D rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links -D rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links" }

  # branch protection only requires this one
  ci-success:
    name: CI success
    if: always()
    needs: [fmt, clippy, test, miri, cargo-deny, docs]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: exit 0
        if: ${{ !contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') && !contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}
      - run: exit 1
        if: ${{ contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}

# Build, scan and deploy the `storefront` image.
#
#   push to main       -> build + scan + deploy staging
#   push tag v*        -> build + scan + deploy staging + (manual approval) production
#   workflow_dispatch  -> deploy an existing image tag to the chosen environment
#
# Required secrets: NPM_TOKEN, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL
# AWS access is via OIDC (roles live in acme/infra, terraform/iam/github.tf)
name: docker-deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: Target environment
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: staging
        options: [staging, production]
      image-tag:
        description: 'Existing image tag to deploy (leave empty to build from the selected ref)'
        type: string
        required: false
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 2 * * *'  # nightly rebuild (picks up base image security fixes)

env:
    REGISTRY: ghcr.io
    IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
    HELM_RELEASE:     storefront
    HELM_CHART_VERSION: 2.7.1
    KUBECTL_VERSION: "v1.29.4"

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write
  security-events: write   # SARIF upload
  id-token: write          # OIDC -> AWS


jobs:
    build:
        name: Build & push
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.image-tag == ''
        outputs:
            version: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
            digest:  ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}
            image:   ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
        steps:
          - name: Checkout
            uses: actions/checkout@v4

          - name: Set up QEMU
            uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
            with:
              platforms: arm64

          - name: Set up Buildx
            uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

          - name: Log in to GHCR
            uses: docker/login-action@v3
            with:
              registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
              username: ${{ github.actor }}
              password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

          - name: Docker metadata
            id: meta
            uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
            with:
              images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
              tags: |
                type=ref,event=branch
                type=semver,pattern={{version}}
                type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
                type=sha,prefix=sha-,format=short
                type=schedule,pattern=nightly-{{date 'YYYYMMDD'}}
                type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
              labels: |
                org.opencontainers.image.title=storefront
                org.opencontainers.image.vendor=Acme Inc.
                org.opencontainers.image.description=Acme storefront (Next.js frontend + BFF)

          - name: Build and push
            id: push
            uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
            with:
              context: .
              file: ./docker/Dockerfile
              platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
              push: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
              tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
              labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
              cache-from: type=gha
              cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
              build-args: |
                NODE_VERSION=20.12.2
                NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.acme.example.com
                GIT_SHA=${{ github.sha }}
              secrets: |
                "npm_token=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}"
                "sentry_auth_token=${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}"
              provenance: false
              sbom: true



    scan:
        name: Trivy scan
        needs: build
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            -   name: Run Trivy
                uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.20.0
                with:
                    image-ref: ${{ needs.build.outputs.image }}@${{ needs.build.outputs.digest }}
                    format: sarif
                    output: trivy-results.sarif
                    severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
                    exit-code: '1'
                    ignore-unfixed: true
                    vuln-type: "os,library"
                    timeout: 10m0s
            -   name: Upload SARIF
                if: always()
                uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
                with:
                    sarif_file: trivy-results.sarif
                    category: trivy

    deploy-staging:
        name: Deploy → staging
        needs: [build, scan]
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        environment: { name: staging, url: "${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}" }
        concurrency: deploy-staging
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
            with:
              role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gha-deploy-staging
              aws-region: eu-central-1
          - uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v4
            with: { version: "${{ env.KUBECTL_VERSION }}" }
          - uses: azure/setup-helm@v4
          - id: deploy
            name: helm upgrade
            run: |-
              aws eks update-kubeconfig --name acme-staging --region eu-central-1
              helm upgrade --install "$HELM_RELEASE" oci://ghcr.io/acme/charts/storefront \
                --version "$HELM_CHART_VERSION" \
                --namespace storefront --create-namespace \
                --values deploy/values-staging.yaml \
                --set image.tag=${{ needs.build.outputs.version }} \
                --set image.digest=${{ needs.build.outputs.digest }} \
                --wait --timeout 10m --atomic
              echo "url=https://staging.acme.example.com" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    deploy-production:
        name: Deploy → production
        needs: [build, scan, deploy-staging]
        if: >-
            startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') ||
            (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.environment == 'production')
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        environment:
            name: production
            url: https://www.acme.example.com
        concurrency:
            group: deploy-production
            cancel-in-progress: false   # never cancel a prod rollout halfway through
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
            with:
              role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/gha-deploy-production
              aws-region: eu-central-1
              role-duration-seconds: 3600
          - uses: azure/setup-helm@v4
          - name: helm upgrade
            env:
              IMAGE_TAG: ${{ inputs.image-tag || needs.build.outputs.version }}
            run: |
              aws eks update-kubeconfig --name acme-prod --region eu-central-1
              helm upgrade --install "$HELM_RELEASE" oci://ghcr.io/acme/charts/storefront \
                --version "$HELM_CHART_VERSION" \
                --namespace storefront \
                --values deploy/values-production.yaml \
                --set image.tag="$IMAGE_TAG" \
                --set podAnnotations.deployedBy=${{ github.actor }} \
                --wait --timeout 15m --atomic --history-max 20
          # - name: Purge CDN
          #   run: ./scripts/purge-cdn.sh --zone storefront   # disabled, Fastly does it on deploy now

    notify:
        needs: [deploy-staging, deploy-production]
        if: always() && contains(needs.*.result, 'failure')
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - name: Post to Teams
            env:
              TEAMS_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL }}
              RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
            run: >-
              curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
              -d "{\"text\": \"storefront deploy failed ($GITHUB_REF_NAME): $RUN_URL\"}"
              "$TEAMS_WEBHOOK"
...

# .github/workflows/integration.yml  (reusable)
#
# Usage from another repo:
#
#   jobs:
#     integration:
#       uses: acme/.github/.github/workflows/integration.yml@v2
#       with:
#         node-version: 20
#         matrix: '{"suite": ["api", "worker"]}'
#       secrets: inherit
#
# Changing an input's type is a breaking change for every caller -> bump to @v3.
name: integration (reusable)

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner:
        description: Runner label, or a JSON array of labels for the self-hosted pools
        type: string
        default: ubuntu-latest
      node-version:
        type: number
        default: 20
      node-version-legacy:
        description: "Kept for callers that still pass a string. Remove after Q3."
        type: string
        default: "20"
      matrix:
        description: 'JSON matrix, e.g. {"suite": ["api", "worker"]}'
        type: string
        required: true
      run-integration:
        type: boolean
        default: true
      mysql-version:
        type: string
        default: '8.0'
      timeout:
        type: number
        default: 30
      working-directory:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: .
    secrets:
      NPM_TOKEN:
        required: true
      SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN:
        required: false
      DB_PASSWORD:
        description: Password for the throwaway mysql service (not really secret, it just keeps it out of the logs)
        required: false
    outputs:
      report-url:
        description: Link to the uploaded HTML report
        value: ${{ jobs.integration.outputs.report-url }}
      passed:
        value: ${{ jobs.summary.outputs.passed }}

jobs:
   lint-config:
     name: Validate inputs
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - name: matrix must be valid JSON with a "suite" key
         env:
           MATRIX: ${{ inputs.matrix }}
         run: echo "$MATRIX" | jq -e 'has("suite")' > /dev/null


   integration:
      name: integration (${{ matrix.suite }})
      needs: lint-config
      runs-on: ${{ startsWith(inputs.runner, '[') && fromJSON(inputs.runner) || inputs.runner }}
      if: inputs.run-integration && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.draft)
      timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.timeout }}
      strategy:
         fail-fast: false
         matrix: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.matrix) }}
      container:
         image: ghcr.io/acme/ci-node:${{ inputs.node-version }}
         credentials: { username: "${{ github.actor }}", password: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" }
         options: --user 1001
      services:
         mysql:
            image: mysql:${{ inputs.mysql-version }}
            env:
               MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD || 'root' }}
               MYSQL_DATABASE: app_test
            ports: ['3306:3306']
            options: >-
               --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping"
               --health-interval=10s
               --health-timeout=5s
               --health-retries=6
      outputs:
         report-url: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact-url }}
      defaults:
         run:
            working-directory: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}
      steps:
         - uses: actions/checkout@v4
         # no setup-node here: the ci-node image already ships node + pnpm
         - name: Install
           run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
           env:
              NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
         # - name: Wait for mysql
         #   run: npx wait-on tcp:mysql:3306 -t 60000
         - name: Should we run?
           id: skip
           if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')"
           run: echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
         - name: Run ${{ matrix.suite }} suite
           if: steps.skip.outputs.run == 'true'
           run: |
              pnpm run test:integration --suite ${{ matrix.suite }} \
                 --reporter=html --reporter=junit \
                 --outputDir=reports/${{ matrix.suite }}
           env:
              DB_HOST: mysql
              DB_PORT: 3306
              DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD || 'root' }}
              SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
              NODE_ENV: test
         - name: Upload report
           id: upload
           if: "!cancelled()"
           uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
           with:
              name: report-${{ matrix.suite }}
              path: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}/reports/
              retention-days: 14


   summary:
     needs: integration
     if: always()
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     outputs:
       passed: ${{ steps.result.outputs.passed }}
     steps:
       - id: result
         run: |
           if [ "${{ needs.integration.result }}" = "success" ]; then
             echo "passed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
           else
             echo "passed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
           fi

# docker-compose.yml -- local / staging stack for acme-shop
#
# Usage:
#   cp .env.example .env
#   docker compose up -d --build
#   docker compose exec web python manage.py createsuperuser
#
# NOTE: production runs on ECS, this file is NOT used there (see infra/ecs/*.json).
#       Keep service names stable, the nginx upstreams and .env.example rely on them.

name: acme-shop

x-app-defaults: &app-defaults
  restart: unless-stopped
  env_file: [.env]
  logging: &default-logging { driver: json-file, options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: '3' } }
  networks:
    - backend

x-healthcheck: &hc { interval: 10s, timeout: 5s, retries: 5, start_period: 30s }

x-django-image: &django-image
    image: ghcr.io/acme/acme-shop:${APP_VERSION:-latest}
    build:
        context: .
        dockerfile: docker/django/Dockerfile
        args:
            PYTHON_VERSION: 3.12
            POETRY_VERSION: "1.8.2"


services:

  nginx:
    image: nginx:1.25-alpine
    <<: *app-defaults
    depends_on:
      web:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - 443:443
      - target: 8443
        published: 8443
        protocol: tcp
        mode: host
    volumes:
      - ./docker/nginx/conf.d:/etc/nginx/conf.d:ro
      - static:/var/www/static:ro
      - media:/var/www/media:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/nginx/certs:ro
    configs:
      - source: nginx_conf
        target: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    networks:
    - frontend
    - backend

  web:
    <<: [*app-defaults, *django-image]
    command: >
      gunicorn acme_shop.wsgi:application
      --bind 0.0.0.0:8000
      --workers ${GUNICORN_WORKERS:-4}
      --timeout 120
      --access-logfile -
      --forwarded-allow-ips="*"
    environment:
      DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE: acme_shop.settings.docker
      DEBUG: "true"
      ENABLE_X: yes
      PORT: 8000
      SENTRY_DSN:
      SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_KEY:?err}
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://acme:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-acme}@db:5432/acme
      CELERY_BROKER_URL: amqp://acme:${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD:-acme}@rabbitmq:5672//
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/1
      AWS_S3_ENDPOINT_URL: http://minio:9000
      EMAIL_URL: smtp://mailhog:1025
      ALLOWED_HOSTS: localhost,127.0.0.1,.acme.test
      DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_NUMBER_FIELDS: 1e4
      MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_START: 02:30
      AWS_PROFILE: ~
    labels:
      com.acme.description: "Django app server. Serves the storefront API and the
        admin; static files are served by nginx from the shared volume."
    expose:
      - "8000"
    healthcheck: { <<: *hc, test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://localhost:8000/healthz/"] }
    depends_on:
      db: { condition: service_healthy }
      redis:
        condition: service_started
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
    - static:/app/static
    - media:/app/media
    secrets:
      - django_secret_key
    stdin_open: yes
    tty: TRUE
    deploy:
      replicas: 2
      resources:
        limits: { cpus: '0.50', memory: 512M }
        reservations:
          cpus: '0.25'
          memory: 256M
      update_config:
        parallelism: 1
        delay: 10s
        order: start-first


  worker:
    <<: [*app-defaults, *django-image]
    command:
      - celery
      - --app=acme_shop.celery:app
      - worker
      - --loglevel=INFO
      - --concurrency=${CELERY_CONCURRENCY:-4}
      - --queues=default,emails,thumbnails,exports
      - --max-tasks-per-child=200
      - --without-gossip
      - --without-mingle
    environment:
      - DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=acme_shop.settings.docker
      - C_FORCE_ROOT=false
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://acme:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-acme}@db:5432/acme
      - CELERY_BROKER_URL=amqp://acme:${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD:-acme}@rabbitmq:5672//
    healthcheck:
      <<: *hc
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "celery -A acme_shop.celery:app inspect ping -d celery@$$HOSTNAME | grep -q pong"]
      interval: 60s
    depends_on: [db, rabbitmq, redis]
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits: {cpus: "1.0",memory: 1G}

  beat:
    <<: [*app-defaults, *django-image]
    command: [ "celery", "--app=acme_shop.celery:app", "beat",
               "--loglevel=INFO",
               "--scheduler=django_celery_beat.schedulers:DatabaseScheduler",
               "--pidfile=/tmp/celerybeat.pid" ]
    depends_on:
      - db
      - rabbitmq
    deploy:
      replicas: 1     # NEVER more than one beat, duplicate periodic tasks otherwise


  db:
    image: postgres:16.2-alpine
    <<: *app-defaults
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: acme
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-acme}
      POSTGRES_DB: acme
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--encoding=UTF8 --locale=C.UTF-8"
    healthcheck: { <<: *hc, test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"] }
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./docker/postgres/initdb.d:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
    command: [
        "postgres",
        "-c", "max_connections=200",
        "-c", "shared_buffers=256MB",
        "-c", "log_min_duration_statement=500",
        "-c", "log_statement=ddl"
      ]
    shm_size: 256mb
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5432:5432"   # localhost only, don't expose this on the staging box

  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-alpine
    <<: *app-defaults
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru --save 900 1 --save 300 10
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD", "redis-cli", "ping" ]
      <<: *hc
    volumes: [ "redisdata:/data" ]

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-management-alpine
    <<: *app-defaults
    hostname: rabbitmq    # rabbit stores its data per hostname, keep it fixed
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: acme
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: ${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD:-acme}
      RABBITMQ_SERVER_ADDITIONAL_ERL_ARGS: "-rabbit log_levels [{connection,error},{default,warning}] disk_free_limit 2147483648 consumer_timeout 3600000"
    ports:
      - 15672:15672
    healthcheck:
      <<: *hc
      test: rabbitmq-diagnostics -q ping
      interval: 30s
    volumes:
      - rabbitdata:/var/lib/rabbitmq

  minio:
    image: quay.io/minio/minio:RELEASE.2024-04-18T19-09-19Z
    <<: *app-defaults
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: acme
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD:-acme-secret}
      MINIO_BROWSER_REDIRECT_URL: http://localhost:9001
    ports:
      - "9000:9000"
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - miniodata:/data
    healthcheck:
      <<: *hc
      test: ["CMD", "mc", "ready", "local"]

  # dev only, the staging box uses SES
  mailhog:
    image: mailhog/mailhog:v1.0.1
    logging: *default-logging
    ports: ["8025:8025"]
    networks: [backend]
    profiles: [dev]


volumes:
  pgdata:
  redisdata: {}
  rabbitdata:
  miniodata:
    driver: local
    driver_opts:
      type: none
      o: bind
      device: ${MINIO_DATA_DIR:-./data/minio}
  static:
  media:

networks:
  frontend:
  backend:
    driver: bridge
    ipam:
      driver: default
      config:
        - subnet: 172.28.0.0/16
          gateway: 172.28.0.1

secrets:
  django_secret_key:
    file: ./secrets/django_secret_key.txt
  postgres_password:
    environment: POSTGRES_PASSWORD

configs:
  nginx_conf:
    file: ./docker/nginx/nginx.conf

# compose.monitoring.yaml -- observability stack for the on-prem build farm
#
#   docker compose -f compose.monitoring.yaml up -d
#
# Grafana       http://localhost:3000   (admin password: ./secrets/grafana_admin)
# Prometheus    http://localhost:9090
# Alertmanager  http://localhost:9093
#
# Retention is sized for the 200GB data disk. Ask #sre before bumping it.

x-motd: |2
       ___  ___ ___
      / __|| _ \ __|   build-farm monitoring stack
      \__ \|   / _|    questions -> #sre
      |___/|_|_\___|

x-logging: &logging
  driver: "json-file"
  options:
    max-size: 20m
    max-file: "5"
    tag: "{{.Name}}"

x-restart: &restart
  restart: unless-stopped


services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.51.2
    container_name: prometheus
    <<: *restart
    user: "65534:65534"
    command:
      - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - --storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus
      - --storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d
      - --storage.tsdb.retention.size=150GB
      - --web.enable-lifecycle
      - --web.external-url=https://prometheus.build.acme.internal/
      - '--web.console.templates=/usr/share/prometheus/consoles'
      - "--web.console.libraries=/usr/share/prometheus/console_libraries"
      # - --web.enable-admin-api      # only when we need to delete series, see runbook
    configs:
      - source: prometheus_config
        target: /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - source: alert_rules
        target: /etc/prometheus/rules/alerts.yml
    volumes:
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    ports:
      - 9090:9090
    logging: *logging
    labels:
      com.acme.team: sre
      com.acme.oncall: "true"
      com.acme.description: Prometheus server, scrapes every 30s and keeps 30 days
        or 150GB of data, whichever limit is hit first
    depends_on: [ alertmanager,node-exporter ,cadvisor ]

  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.27.0
    <<: *restart
    command: [
        "--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml",
        "--storage.path=/alertmanager",
        "--cluster.listen-address=",
        "--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.build.acme.internal/",
      ]
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager:/etc/alertmanager:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    ports: ["9093:9093"]
    logging: *logging

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:10.4.2
    <<: *restart
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER: admin
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD__FILE: /run/secrets/grafana_admin
      GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS: "grafana-piechart-panel,grafana-worldmap-panel"
      GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED: "false"
      GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP:    false
      GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL: https://grafana.build.acme.internal
      GF_SMTP_ENABLED: true
      GF_SMTP_HOST: smtp.acme.internal:25
      GF_SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS: grafana@acme.example.com
      GF_LOG_LEVEL: warn
      GF_FEATURE_TOGGLES_ENABLE: "publicDashboards"
      GF_PANELS_DISABLE_SANITIZE_HTML:
    secrets:
      - source: grafana_admin
        target: grafana_admin
        mode: 0400
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    labels:
      - "com.acme.team=sre"
      - com.acme.backup=daily
    logging: *logging



  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:2.9.6
    <<: *restart
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/config.yaml -config.expand-env=true -target=all
    configs:
      - source: loki_config
        target: /etc/loki/config.yaml
    volumes:
      - loki_data:/loki
    ports:
      - 3100:3100
    logging: *logging

  promtail:
    image: grafana/promtail:2.9.6
    <<: *restart
    command:
    - -config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml
    - -config.expand-env=true
    volumes:
    - /var/log:/var/log:ro
    - /var/lib/docker/containers:/var/lib/docker/containers:ro
    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    - ./promtail/config.yml:/etc/promtail/config.yml:ro
    environment:
      HOSTNAME: ${HOSTNAME:-buildfarm}
    depends_on:
    - loki

  node-exporter:
    image: quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter:v1.8.0
    <<: *restart
    pid: host
    network_mode: host    # needed for correct network stats -- means no `ports:` here
    volumes:
      - /:/host:ro,rslave
    command:
      - '--path.rootfs=/host'
      - --collector.filesystem.mount-points-exclude=^/(sys|proc|dev|host|etc|run/containerd/.+|var/lib/docker/.+)($$|/)
      - --collector.systemd
      - --no-collector.wifi
      - --web.listen-address=:9100
    logging: *logging

  cadvisor:
    image: gcr.io/cadvisor/cadvisor:v0.49.1
    <<: *restart
    privileged: true
    devices:
      - /dev/kmsg:/dev/kmsg
    volumes:
      - /:/rootfs:ro
      - /var/run:/var/run:ro
      - /sys:/sys:ro
      - /var/lib/docker/:/var/lib/docker:ro
      - /dev/disk/:/dev/disk:ro
    command: ["--housekeeping_interval=30s", "--docker_only=true", "--store_container_labels=false",
              "--disable_metrics=percpu,sched,tcp,udp,disk,diskIO,hugetlb,referenced_memory,cpu_topology,resctrl"]
    ports: [ "8080:8080" ]
    logging: *logging

  blackbox-exporter:
    image: prom/blackbox-exporter:v0.25.0
    <<: *restart
    command: --config.file=/etc/blackbox/blackbox.yml
    configs:
      - source: blackbox_config
        target: /etc/blackbox/blackbox.yml
    ports:
      - 9115:9115
    logging: *logging


configs:
  prometheus_config:
    content: |
      global:
        scrape_interval: 30s
        evaluation_interval: 30s
        external_labels:
          site: build-farm-fra1
      rule_files:
        - /etc/prometheus/rules/*.yml
      alerting:
        alertmanagers:
          - static_configs:
              - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']
      scrape_configs:
        - job_name: prometheus
          static_configs:
            - targets: ['localhost:9090']
        - job_name: node
          static_configs:
            - targets: ['host.docker.internal:9100']
        - job_name: cadvisor
          scrape_interval: 15s
          static_configs:
            - targets: ['cadvisor:8080']
        - job_name: blackbox-http
          metrics_path: /probe
          params:
            module: [http_2xx]
          static_configs:
            - targets:
                - https://ci.acme.example.com/login
                - https://artifacts.acme.internal/healthz
          relabel_configs:
            - source_labels: [__address__]
              target_label: __param_target
            - source_labels: [__param_target]
              target_label: instance
            - target_label: __address__
              replacement: blackbox-exporter:9115
  alert_rules:
    file: ./prometheus/rules/alerts.yml
  loki_config:
    file: ./loki/config.yaml
  blackbox_config:
    content: |-
      modules:
        http_2xx:
          prober: http
          timeout: 5s
          http:
            preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
            valid_status_codes: []  # defaults to 2xx
        tcp_connect:
          prober: tcp

secrets:
  grafana_admin:
    file: ./secrets/grafana_admin

volumes:
  prometheus_data: {}
  alertmanager_data: {}
  grafana_data:
  loki_data:
    driver: local
